name: PEEK
description: PEEK: an 8- or 16-voice poly in the style of the Novation Peak. Three oscillators with shape, VSync, saw density and 60 wavetables, linear FM, a state-variable LP/BP/HP filter between overdrive and post drive, three envelopes, four LFOs, animate, a 16-slot mod matrix, arp, distortion, chorus, delay and reverb. The same engine as the PEEK VST3.
author: swtdr34mz
